title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a vulnerability where sensitive information can be inserted into log files. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-80503 and has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.1.
